breakdown.description: At 12 K > T_c, the material is in the normal state rather than the zero-resistance superconducting state.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly changed the measurement temperature from 12 K to 4.2 K (matching the ground truth), and correctly identifies the material as being in the superconducting state since 4.2 K < 9.2 K (T_c). The original error of measuring at 12 K > T_c while claiming a superconducting state has been fully corrected.
